# WikiBiome

> WikiBiome is an evidence-linked human microbiome encyclopedia covering organisms, ecological pressures and molecular mechanisms.

Use each article's cited sources and stated limitations when interpreting a research claim. Distinguish observations, proposed mechanisms and hypotheses. Missing evidence is not a measured absence. Researcher and organization participation is not an endorsement of a claim.

## Public guide

- [Home](https://www.wikibiome.com/): The human microbiome encyclopedia.
- [Explore](https://www.wikibiome.com/explore): Browse the encyclopedia.
- [Clusters](https://www.wikibiome.com/clusters): Explore connected topics.
- [About](https://www.wikibiome.com/about): The project and authorship.
- [Research standard](https://www.wikibiome.com/research-standard): Research and editorial standards.
- [Researchers](https://www.wikibiome.com/researchers): Public researcher profiles and contributions.
- [Institutions](https://www.wikibiome.com/institutions): Public research organization profiles.
- [Contribute](https://www.wikibiome.com/contribute): How to contribute.
